long_biography.plain_text:
Food enterprises supplied the engine of Gary Rodney Lane's business career. He owned Healtheries for sixteen years and also controlled Hansells, building value in established New Zealand health-products and food brands before selling both in 2006. An earlier reported sale of Australian-based Lanes Food Group to Kraft had already established a pattern of developing consumer businesses and then redeploying the proceeds through investment.

Lane's public work later broadened through Lane Capital Group, conservation and educational philanthropy. He created a predator-protected sanctuary at Wairakei that has raised kiwi for release, funded a dedicated hatchery and served on the board of the national predator-eradication programme. The Lane Capital Scholarship at the University of Auckland has long supported students facing financial hardship. New Zealand appointed him an Officer of the New Zealand Order of Merit in 2025 for services to conservation and philanthropy.
